snippet.title: Ye Guild Clerk! - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The local Adventurer's Guild is hiring!... Not for adventurers, but for guild clerks! You play an important role in handing out quests, gold, and equipment as your actions shape the stories of these animal adventurers for better, or for worse..!

Play now!
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3715020/Ye_Guild_Clerk/
